explanationTemplate: The output switches between HIGH and LOW.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show current only after the validator proves a closed path from the supply, through the load, and back to ground.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map controller LOW/HIGH output to the visible off/on state of the connected load.

animationCues: off state has no load animation
on state animates along validated current path
limitations: Does not solve switching transients or semiconductor curves.

explanationTemplate: The Arduino turns the output on and off repeatedly.

currentPathRecipe.description: Alternate the validated current path between active and inactive animation phases.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Use a repeated timer to explain blink periods without claiming real firmware timing precision.

animationCues: pulse current dots only during the on phase
fade the load body during the off phase
limitations: Timer is educational and not calibrated to an actual Arduino sketch loop.

explanationTemplate: The analog knob value maps to PWM duty cycle, changing LED brightness in the educational simulation.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show the potentiometer sensing divider separately from the PWM-controlled LED load current.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map the simulated knob value to an educational PWM brightness state.

animationCues: show a muted analog signal path
change LED glow intensity with knob value
animate PWM-controlled load current
limitations: Models classroom PWM brightness qualitatively; it does not simulate analog transients or LED luminous intensity calibration.

explanationTemplate: When the sensor value crosses the threshold, the output changes.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show the low-current sensing path separately from any validated output load current path.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Convert the simulated analog input value into a discrete educational state.

animationCues: show sensing path with a muted color
highlight output path only when threshold is crossed
limitations: Does not model ADC noise, impedance, or continuous brightness curves unless a more specific primitive is added.

explanationTemplate: The display shows a fixed message.

currentPathRecipe.description: Animate OLED supply current only on the validated power and ground loop; show SDA/SCL as signal activity, not load current.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Render a static text state on the display once power, ground, SDA, and SCL are valid.

animationCues: animate supply current separately from I2C signal pulses
pulse SDA and SCL with distinct signal colors
limitations: Does not emulate SSD1306 commands or I2C timing; it explains steady educational behavior.

explanationTemplate: The display shows a sensor reading.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show sensor and display supply paths separately; signal lines carry state changes, not load current.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map simulated sensor input to formatted display text.

animationCues: pulse sensor signal before display update
animate display supply current after validation
limitations: Only supports educational readout behavior for sensors represented in the context layer.

explanationTemplate: The buzzer pulses when the condition is true.

currentPathRecipe.description: Animate the buzzer path only during the simulated pulse window.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent sound as a visual pulse and label rather than generated audio.

animationCues: pulse the buzzer body
show short current bursts through the buzzer load
limitations: Does not synthesize actual frequency response or loudness.

explanationTemplate: The servo moves to an educational angle.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show servo supply current separately from the PWM control signal.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map PWM setting to a visible servo arm angle for teaching.

animationCues: rotate servo horn
show muted PWM pulses on signal wire
warn when current exceeds classroom source assumptions
limitations: Does not model stall current, torque, inertia, or external power supply behavior.

explanationTemplate: The simulator shows why the circuit is not safe to run.

currentPathRecipe.description: Do not show current paths; highlight the validation issue and explain the missing or unsafe condition.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent invalid or unsupported circuits as blocked simulation states.

animationCues: highlight unsafe endpoints
disable current-flow dots
limitations: Explains validation failures; it is not a repair solver by itself.

explanationTemplate: Animated dots follow only validated closed current paths.

currentPathRecipe.description: Use only current path ids returned by deterministic validation and current estimation tools.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Animate only when the associated simulation plan is valid.

animationCues: dots follow wire endpoint order
invalid paths remain disabled
limitations: Shows direction and relative presence of current, not a SPICE-grade transient or field solution.

explanationTemplate: The Arduino reads a HIGH/LOW input state from a switch or digital sensor.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show powered sensor supply current when present, and always show digital signal activity separately from output load current.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map the input pin to an educational inactive/active state without claiming calibrated sensing.

animationCues: pulse the digital input wire when the input changes
keep input signal activity separate from LED/output current
limitations: Models only qualitative HIGH/LOW or pulse activity; it does not decode protocols, debounce contacts, or calibrate sensor values.

explanationTemplate: The Arduino scans multiple switch or row/column input lines and shows the qualitative key state.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show row scan and key sense activity separately from display I2C activity.

pathTemplates.label: Matrix input key or switch signal

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map the simulated input pattern to a qualitative display state.

animationCues: pulse row scan lines
pulse the active column or switch input line
update OLED text after the input event
limitations: Models qualitative key/switch state only; it does not simulate contact bounce or full keyboard firmware.

explanationTemplate: The Arduino reads joystick X/Y analog axes and a push switch, then shows qualitative position on the display.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show joystick supply current, X/Y analog signals, switch state, and display bus activity separately.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Map simulated X/Y slider positions and switch state to qualitative OLED text.

animationCues: show X/Y analog signal activity
pulse SW when pressed
update OLED position text
limitations: Models qualitative joystick position only; it is not calibrated physical force or gamepad HID behavior.

explanationTemplate: The Arduino reads CLK/DT quadrature changes and the push switch, then shows qualitative rotation state.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show encoder supply current, CLK/DT/SW signal activity, and display bus activity separately.

pathTemplates.label: Rotary encoder quadrature or switch signal

animationCues: alternate CLK and DT signal pulses
pulse SW when pressed
update OLED count/direction text

explanationTemplate: The bare 7-segment display lights only the validated current-limited segments.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show one current path per driven segment, each from an Arduino output through its own resistor and segment LED to common ground.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Render a qualitative digit from the segment pins that passed per-segment resistor validation.

animationCues: animate each validated segment current path independently
do not animate a segment pin that lacks its own resistor
limitations: Uses the app's simplified visual pin set and qualitative segment state; it does not model every commercial 10-pin 7-segment package.

explanationTemplate: The LED array display shows a qualitative number or pixel pattern.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show LED display module supply current separately from data, clock, and chip-select signal activity.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Render a qualitative digit or dot pattern after power, ground, and control lines are valid.

animationCues: animate supply current on the display power loop
pulse data and clock/control lines as signal activity
limitations: Models qualitative display state only; it does not emulate TM1637 or MAX7219 command timing.

explanationTemplate: The addressable LED ring shows a qualitative RGB pattern.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show addressable LED supply current separately from the one-wire data stream; warn that real full-brightness current may need external power.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Render a qualitative RGB pattern after power, ground, and DIN are valid.

animationCues: animate supply current on the ring power loop
pulse DIN as single-wire data activity
limitations: Models qualitative color/pattern state only; it does not emulate WS2812B timing or full current draw.

explanationTemplate: The SPI display shows qualitative text, image, or graphic state once power, ground, and SPI-style control lines are valid.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show SPI display module supply current separately from data, clock, chip-select, and optional command/reset signal activity.

animationCues: animate supply current on the display power loop
pulse SPI data, clock, and chip-select lines as signal activity
limitations: Models qualitative display state only; it does not emulate device command timing, frame buffers, color calibration, or e-paper waveforms.

explanationTemplate: The RGB LED mixes color by lighting validated current-limited red, green, and blue channels.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show one current path per driven RGB channel after each channel has its own series resistor and the common cathode returns to ground.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Render a qualitative color mix based on the driven channels rather than calibrated LED spectra.

animationCues: animate only channels with validated resistor paths
blend the LED glow qualitatively from active channel colors
limitations: Does not model exact wavelength, brightness matching, or PWM color calibration.

explanationTemplate: The powered light module turns on when supply, ground, and the control signal are valid.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show module supply current separately from the low-current digital control signal.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent module output as qualitative visible light with a safety caution where appropriate.

animationCues: animate supply current on the power loop
pulse the control signal separately from load current
limitations: Does not model optical power, driver circuitry, or eye-safety classification.

explanationTemplate: The stepper advances in qualitative steps only after a validated driver path is present.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show qualitative coil current through the driver separately from the low-current controller step or phase signals.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent stepper position and direction qualitatively, not as calibrated torque, acceleration, or microstep physics.

animationCues: pulse driver control signals before each qualitative step
animate coil current through the driver and motor
show a current-limit warning badge for real stepper builds
limitations: Does not model real torque, speed, acceleration, microstepping, heat, or current-limit settings.
Real stepper builds need a suitable driver, supply, common ground, and current-limit setup outside this educational simulation.

explanationTemplate: The motor-like load turns on through a validated low-side driver path.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show the load current path through the driver separately from the low-current controller signal.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent motor, fan, pump, solenoid, or haptic module output as qualitative on/off or PWM-controlled state.

animationCues: animate load current through the driver path
pulse the control signal separately from load current
show a protection warning badge for real inductive loads
limitations: Does not model stall current, torque, airflow, water flow, coil temperature, PWM frequency response, or external power supply design.
Real inductive loads require power, current, thermal, and flyback/protection design outside this educational simulation.

explanationTemplate: The DC motor changes qualitative direction only after a validated H-bridge driver path is present.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show qualitative motor current through the H-bridge separately from the low-current controller enable and direction signals.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent motor direction qualitatively without claiming calibrated speed, torque, current, or thermal behavior.

animationCues: pulse enable and direction lines separately from motor current
animate motor current through the H-bridge and motor only when enabled
show a current/thermal warning badge for real motor-driver builds
limitations: Does not model stall current, back EMF, speed, torque, braking physics, heat, or driver voltage drop.
Real H-bridge motor builds need supply, current, thermal, flyback/driver, and common-ground design outside this educational simulation.

explanationTemplate: The relay contact changes state only for a validated low-voltage classroom load path.

currentPathRecipe.description: Show the relay input control signal separately from the low-voltage contact-side load current.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Represent relay contact state qualitatively and only for safe low-voltage classroom loads.

animationCues: pulse the relay input line when the coil is energized
animate contact-side current only in the low-voltage load loop
show a mains-blocked warning badge for real relay projects
limitations: Does not model relay coil transients, contact bounce, isolation spacing, contact rating, or mains wiring.
Mains, outlet, or wall-power relay loads are blocked; only low-voltage classroom substitutions are eligible for simulation.

explanationTemplate: The declared low-voltage source energizes the breadboard positive and ground rails in a qualitative rail-state simulation.

currentPathRecipe.description: No load current is animated for an unloaded rail; the simulation reports validated rail polarity and ground reference as state evidence.

animationCues: show a rail-state badge instead of load-current dots when no load is present
highlight positive and ground rails after polarity validation
limitations: Does not calculate battery capacity, adapter current limit, voltage sag, heating, or protection behavior.

explanationTemplate: The 7805 regulator is represented as a qualitative 5V rail after IN, GND, and OUT wiring are validated.

currentPathRecipe.description: No load current is animated for an unloaded regulator rail; the simulation reports validated 5V output state evidence.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Show the 7805 output as a qualitative regulated 5V rail after input, output, and common ground validation.

animationCues: show input and output rail badges without pretending thermal or dropout analysis

explanationTemplate: The passive component is represented as low-voltage context with pin and polarity evidence; passive-only circuits do not animate active current flow.

currentPathRecipe.description: Do not synthesize load current for passive-only protection/filtering context; show only validated part state, pins, and polarity.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Show the passive part role and, where applicable, its polarity orientation without claiming real protection performance.

animationCues: show a passive role badge rather than current-flow dots
highlight polarized pins for electrolytic capacitors and diodes
limitations: Does not calculate capacitance, inductance, diode drop, fuse trip current, clamp voltage, surge energy, or thermal behavior.
Mains, wall-power, and MOV/varistor protection circuits are blocked for student breadboard simulation.

explanationTemplate: The timing passive is represented as a qualitative reference component; oscillator startup, frequency tolerance, and clock timing are not simulated.

currentPathRecipe.description: Do not synthesize oscillator current or calibrated clock waveforms; show the reference component and terminal roles only.

expectedStateRecipe.description: Show the crystal/timing passive as a qualitative clock reference with labeled terminals.

animationCues: show a timing-reference badge instead of clock waveform animation
highlight X1 and X2 terminal labels

Use only as low-voltage educational context.

explanationTemplate: The prototyping surface is represented as placement/build context; it does not energize rails or create electrical nets by itself.

animationCues: show a surface-context badge instead of current-flow dots

Mains, wall-power, and high-risk fabrication processes are blocked for student simulation.

explanationTemplate: The connector is represented as low-voltage wiring context with pin anchors; it does not create a voltage source or implicit short.

explanationTemplate: The controller board is represented as board-specific pin-map and voltage-domain context; circuit current flow is not synthesized until the selected circuit bundle explicitly supports that board.

animationCues: show controller pin labels instead of current-flow dots

limitations: Does not emulate firmware, USB, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cloud behavior, or board-specific peripheral timing.
